2609.39882.title: LLM Persona Unlearning
2609.39882.paper_summary: Pre-training equips large language models (LLMs) with a broad repertoire of behavioral patterns associated with roles, styles, values, and goals. Post-training teaches conditional enactment and makes a helpful Assistant the default, but it does not erase alternative modes from the weights; explicit prompts can therefore elicit personas that repeatedly shape judgment, language, and action. In open-weight settings, runtime controls can be removed, motivating persona unlearning: a weight-level edit that makes a designated persona difficult to elicit and enact on unseen contexts. We introduce PersonaUnlearnBench, a model-specific paired benchmark spanning six LLMs from three families and five personas, with aligned forget/retain sets, held-out instruction paraphrases, and four-axis evaluation. The benchmark shows that standard unlearning methods cannot reliably erase the target persona without sacrificing meaningful generation or general utility. We therefore propose PaCE, which compares target and desirable responses to the same questions to locate an internal behavior direction, then trains target-prompt states away from the target mode and toward the matched desirable response. Experiments show that PaCE consistently suppresses target personas with high response quality and useful counterpart behavior, at moderate utility cost. These results establish persona unlearning as a distinct behavior-level editing problem and a practical route toward persistent control of latent LLM response policies.
2609.39882.paper_summary_zh: 預訓練使大型語言模型（LLMs）具備與角色、風格、價值觀和目標相關的廣泛行為模式。後訓練教授條件性執行，並使有用的助手成為預設選項，但並不會從權重中抹去替代模式；因此，明確的提示可以引出重複塑造判斷、語言和行動的人格。在開放權重設置中，可以移除運行時控制，促進人格的遺忘：這是一種權重級別的編輯，使指定的人格在未見的情境中難以引出和執行。我們引入了PersonaUnlearnBench，這是一個特定於模型的配對基準，涵蓋來自三個家族的六個LLM和五個人格，並具有對應的遺忘/保留集、保留的指令改寫和四軸評估。基準顯示，標準的遺忘方法無法可靠地抹去目標人格，而不犧牲有意義的生成或一般效用。因此，我們提出了PaCE，它比較對同一問題的目標和期望回應，以定位內部行為方向，然後將目標提示狀態從目標模式訓練到匹配的期望回應。實驗顯示，PaCE持續壓制目標人格，並具有高回應質量和有用的對應行為，且效用成本適中。這些結果確立了人格遺忘作為一個獨特的行為級別編輯問題，並為持久控制潛在LLM回應政策提供了一條實用的途徑。
